description: This file contains unit tests for the CsrfUtil class in the org.apache.ofbiz.security package. It tests various functionalities related to CSRF token handling such as token retrieval, generation, URL parameter management, and request mapping logic.

classes.name: CsrfUtilTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing CSRF utility functions in the CsrfUtil class.

methods.name: testGetTokenMap
methods.description: Tests retrieval of CSRF token map from session, including scenarios with and without user login.

methods.name: testGetRequestUriWithSubFolderLimit
methods.description: Tests extraction of request URI with subfolder limit applied.

methods.name: testGetRequestUriFromPath
methods.description: Tests parsing of request URI from various path formats.

methods.name: testGenerateTokenForNonAjax
methods.description: Tests CSRF token generation for non-AJAX requests, including support for request map and path limits.

methods.name: testFindRequestMapWithoutControlPath
methods.description: Verifies request map retrieval logic for various URL patterns, including REST and view paths.

methods.name: testGenerateTokenForAjax
methods.description: Tests retrieval of CSRF token for AJAX requests.

methods.name: testGetTokenForAjax
methods.description: Verifies fetching the CSRF token stored in session for AJAX requests.

methods.name: testAddOrUpdateTokenInUrl
methods.description: Tests adding or updating CSRF token parameter in URLs.

methods.name: testAddOrUpdateTokenInQueryString
methods.description: Tests adding or updating CSRF token parameter in query strings.
